measured_by: gen_atlas_rows.py (header record of Dan_atlas_dimensions.v1.jsonl); re-measured in part by check_atlas_rows.py
limits: The shared atlas feed was not pinned and was not read; its field names and vocabulary are constants taken from the earlier tool's form (INFERRED to match the live feed, not MEASURED).
Blast-radius classes, divergence statements and hardness are JUDGED_BY_RULE over word matches; no one re-read the passages.
Unresolved entries in packets and rulings are recorded as raised; their later disposition is not derived.
Linkages are harvested by unit id only; chapter:verse cross-references are not harvested.
Severity counts do not deduplicate one finding repeated by a later round.
Sentences are split at full stops and semicolons; some transcribed sentences begin mid-clause, and row-internal labels such as region letters can travel.
The checker shares no code with the generator but has the same author and model family (OW-19): not independent review.
No row was changed and no boundary judged.
